choices.why: No green option exists, so this deep-toned three-seat velvet sofa is the closest match to the requested dark velvet sofa and anchors the space facing the black fireplace.
A pair of classic upholstered armchairs with nailhead trim and a dark wood base brings tailored elegance on both sides of the fireplace.
The large Persian-style medallion rug is truly traditional, and its warm reds and golds suit the old moulded room and the light wood floor.
Dark espresso wood with a classic X-base and a size that fits between the sofa and the fireplace.
A large decorative mirror about one metre wide, in the right proportion to the chimney breast, whose classic geometric frame matches the mouldings.
Its pleated fabric shade and traditional base give a classic touch next to an armchair.

answer.why: A dark velvet sofa, upholstered armchairs with dark wood and a Persian rug in warm tones frame the black marble fireplace, giving the old room with mint walls and coffered ceiling a classic, elegant feel. The decorative mirror and the pleated-shade lamp complete the traditional look.
